qualification.scope: The exact four protected OTP-H-GAPCVP targets and promise interfaces under their recorded restrictions and classifications only.
mandatory_qualifications: Gap denominators are dimension-dependent exponents, not constant approximation factors.
The Euclidean target remains integer-target restricted and the syndrome target remains consistent-system restricted.
Generator orientation remains only the protected transpose convention.
Malformed and threshold-intermediate inputs remain outside the promise.
The finite-p target uses fixed rational p at least one external to the input encoding.

claim_boundary: This restricted qualification applies only to the exact four protected OTP-H-GAPCVP targets and promise interfaces and preserves their dimension-dependent gap factors, integer-target and consistent-syndrome restrictions, generator transpose convention, outside-promise boundary, fixed rational p scope, classifications, and permitted axioms. It records no assertion that a mathematical target has thereby become proved, independently certifies no complete source proof body, totalizes no malformed or threshold-intermediate input, establishes no whole-document or full proof-body equivalence, creates no authority for another family or aggregate object, and authorizes no novelty, priority, publication, patentability, product, or commercial claim.
